lines.en: The grass makes no sound where I pass.
I am not fast, but I keep approaching.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脚步声很空。
lines.en: Step by step, my footsteps sound hollow.
I walk the outer wall of the house.

lines.zh: 我走过时，火把会暗一下。
lines.en: Torches dim when I pass.

lines.zh: 我从树林边出来，又进去。
lines.en: I come out of the treeline and back in.
I walk straight, not looking at the path.

lines.zh: 我的身体边缘在轻轻晃。
lines.en: The edges of my body waver.
I come toward you. No reason needed.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，气温低了一点。
lines.en: The air cools a little where I pass.

lines.zh: 我每走一段，就更清楚一点。
lines.en: Each stretch I walk, I become a little clearer.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一团没定形的东西。
lines.en: I stand, like something not yet shaped.

lines.zh: 我在等自己变得更完整。
lines.en: I am waiting to become more complete.

lines.zh: 你没有回头，但我在这里。
lines.en: You have not looked back. I am here.
I need not knock.
My breathing is a borrowed sound.

lines.zh: 我在你窗户外站了很久。
lines.en: I stood outside your window a long time.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在月光下不太对。
lines.en: My outline is wrong in the moonlight.
I remember how you walk.
I will slowly become something else.

lines.zh: 我在等一个恰当的时刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for the right moment.
My shadow always points at you.

lines.zh: 我很安静，安静得不像在。
lines.en: I am quiet, quiet enough to seem absent.
These wounds do not take me.
Only fire will scatter me.
You looked. That is late enough.
First comes me. Then comes it.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离没变过。
lines.en: The distance between us has not changed.
Every step you take, I take one too.
Do not put your hand into the shadow.

lines.zh: 你听见的是自己的呼吸。
lines.en: What you hear is your own breathing.
I do not intend to explain.
I have chosen this ground.

lines.zh: 你屋里那盏灯，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the lamp in your house.
I stood behind you all night.
You will slowly stop remembering.
I come first; it follows.
I do not need your name.
You retreat, and still I do not leave.
Look at me once more.
Do you know this face?
I look like you, do I not?
You slept very deeply.
Now it is your turn to not wake up.
I scattered a little.

lines.zh: 伤口一会儿就自己合上了。
lines.en: The wound closes by itself in a moment.
Such wounds do not take me.
I gather again quickly.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍进雾里，我散成两半。
lines.en: Your blade cuts into fog and I split in two.
I wavered, then steadied.
This body was never solid.

lines.zh: 火是我的尽头，别的不是。
lines.en: Fire is my end. Nothing else.
No mouth on this face; no words.
You hold food up to empty air.

lines.zh: 这东西在你手里，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see it in your hand.
I do not want it. I want you here.
Keep it and eat it slowly.
Move it. It blocks my view of you.
Smells do not reach me.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在门口就好。
lines.en: Just leave it at the door.
What your hand touched was cold.
I need not step back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己散了一点。
lines.en: That scattered a little of me.

lines.zh: 你撞开的地方，很快合上。
lines.en: What you broke closes quickly.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我还在原处。
lines.en: You gave half a step. I am still here.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有皮可以撞。
lines.en: There is no skin between us to collide.
You touched it and felt nothing.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，你就知道预兆。
lines.en: One touch and you'll know what an omen feels like.
I need no mate.
I am only a precursor.
Wait until I become the other thing.

lines.zh: 我没有同类，只有后来者。
lines.en: I have no kin, only what comes after.
Say that to the living.
Say that and I will learn it.
My shape is not given.
I am learning your speech.
You are trembling all over.
Leave it. Do not ask.
It is not cold in my hand.
I cannot see it clearly.
I hold it up to your face.
I have recorded this weight.
It fell, without sound.
I put it in your pocket.
Tomorrow you will not find it.
This is yours.
I hold it, learning your hand.
You are standing right there.
I have your outline.
This step is closer than the last.
That sound is me.
You stand in the doorway, still.
I never hurry to close in.
You need not turn around.
I am already in your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的手已经抬到你肩后。
lines.en: My hand is already behind your shoulder.
This time you will see me.
Do you still recognize it?
I am clearer than yesterday.
The further you go, the closer I am.
You changed path; so did I.

lines.zh: 你回头，那里什么也没有。
lines.en: Look back — there is nothing there.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步，比你的慢半拍。
lines.en: The footsteps you hear lag half a beat behind yours.
The lamplight passes through me.
The omen arrives before the footsteps.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有一扇门，我知道。
lines.en: This room has only one door; I know it.
I am counting. You are not.

lines.zh: 你身后的影子多了一个。
lines.en: There is one more shadow behind you.
You are beginning to doubt yourself.
Nothing could be better.
I am forgetting your name.
Walk on a little more.
Here is good enough.
I touched you.

lines.zh: 你没有感觉，但你已经变了。
lines.en: You felt nothing, but you have changed.
My hand is very light.
This does not hurt at all.

lines.zh: 我贴着你耳朵，呼出一口冷气。
lines.en: I press against your ear and breathe out cold air.

lines.zh: 我把你的一部分拿走了。
lines.en: I took a part of you.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，什么也没抓到。
lines.en: I grabbed and caught nothing.
You are starting to forget just now.
This is slower than a blade.

lines.zh: 你退了，可你退不了多远。
lines.en: You retreated, but not far.
I stay right against you.
Your shadow is mine now.
I step back so you think it is over.
Next time you will not know me.
You have already begun to forget.

lines.zh: 我先是一道影子出现在墙上。
lines.en: First I am a shadow on the wall.
There is breathing in the house.
I have no shape yet.

lines.zh: 空气在我站的地方变冷。
lines.en: The air cools where I stand.
I try to raise a hand.
It slowly shows.
The trees outside are moving.
I hear someone turn over inside.

lines.zh: 这只是开始，我还没成形。
lines.en: This is only the beginning; I have no shape yet.
I will become the other thing.
For now I am only a sign.
Light leaks under the door.
I move toward that light.

lines.zh: 屋角的空气先冷下来，然后是我。
lines.en: The air in the corner cools first, and then I arrive.
Footsteps stop at the door.
The lamp inside is still lit.
I wait for it to go out.

lines.zh: 我在门外的黑里站了整整一夜。
lines.en: I stood all night in the dark outside the door.
Now it begins.
Fire touches me and I begin to come apart.

lines.zh: 我落下去，形状散了一次。
lines.en: I fall, and my shape loosens once.

lines.zh: 水浸过我，我反而更清楚。
lines.en: Water passes through; I become clearer.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹开，我又慢慢回来。
lines.en: The blast blows me apart; I slowly return.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，没有留下洞。
lines.en: Something passes through and leaves no hole.

lines.zh: 咒力碰到我，我被推远了一点。
lines.en: The curse touches me and pushes me back a little.
Hunger is not something I learned.
The lightning shows what I look like.

lines.zh: 我落进黑里，还在看着你。
lines.en: I fall into the dark, still watching you.
